title: Trace CI admission cascades before debugging target code
applies_when: A hosted PR check is red or skipped, but the test/lint/build stage may not have been admitted; another service reports a dependent build failure.
lesson: Read the first failing stage's annotations and actual command output at the PR head before buying an environment rebuild, changing code or requesting a rerun. Distinguish an authorization/admission refusal from an assertion, compiler or formatter failure. Trace downstream checks back to that cause: a documentation job can exit before creating its environment because it gates on a failed pre-run-check. Preserve the raw red state and exact commit, but route the authorization wait to the maintainer rather than labeling the candidate a test failure or claiming CI passed. Reuse upstream_review_state's MAINTAINER_AUTHORIZATION classification when supported by the inspected evidence. Read the current repository's rules before any label/review request; do not bypass a guard, forge trusted status, or ask a human to proxy an agent-forbidden request.
avoid_when: The same run can contain an independent code failure: do not excuse all red checks from one gate annotation, infer all logs from a status title, or treat skipped checks as green tests. Unknown mergeability and missing/truncated logs remain unknown. A Ready PR is not proof of passing local qualification, hosted CI, maintainer review or merge acceptance. Labels, thresholds and project policy change; the observed vLLM rule is not a universal contribution ban or an authorization to rerun. This scoped diagnosis establishes no discovery, PR-conversion or measured cost benefit.

evidence.note: At PR62399 head2cfb963, the public failed job annotation requires a qualifying label or four merged PRs and reports one. It explicitly forbids an AI agent from requesting the label. Observed2026-10-20; this is an admission failure, not a target test assertion or a guarantee about current/future author eligibility.

This same-head failed build's public command output stops at docs/pre_run_check.sh after observing failed pre-commit/pre-run-check. No environment creation, documentation dependency installation or MkDocs command ran. The generic build-failed notice alone did not explain that dependency.

Pinned source gates external PR documentation builds on head-specific pre-run-check conclusions and exits1 for failure/cancel/timeout. Other paths can skip, bypass via a maintainer-owned label, or proceed when no check/API data is available; inspect the actual run rather than generalizing a gate from this script alone.
